blocks.text: Structural biology mein macromolecules (bare molecules, jaise proteins aur nucleic acids) ki three dimensional (3D, teen rukh wali) structure ko atomic level par parha jata hai. Is se kisi biomolecule ki structure, us ke kaam (functions), us ki harkat (dynamics), aur ligands (us se judne wale chhote molecules) aur doosre macromolecules ke saath us ke rabte (interaction) ki poori maloomat milti hai.
Structural biology ke bohat se faide (applications) hain, khaas kar medical research mein. In mein se kuch yeh hain:
